source.quote: 然後請注意這種查驗功能不要影響到主要核心功能。它只是一個包一個方便的開發工具的模式。

requirements: Object inspection is an optional outer presentation/development helper using existing owner-provided public readonly projections. No new Graph/model ownership, core reflection API, synchronized mirror store or serialization authority.
Obtain detail on explicit F2 action; do not add whole-model capture/serialization on normal pointer movement or make core editing depend on inspection registration. Preserve ordinary hints.
Inspection cannot change selection, Graph values/revision/dirty/History/Redo, document storage/ACK or shader generation. Focus/text/draft/IME/gesture guards remain; closing returns safe focus.

Failure, unavailable targets, projection errors, same-ID replacement, unmount/dispose or late callbacks remain isolated to the helper. No stale authority, leaked listener/timer, core command suppression or core crash.

Use the accepted public view/mount optional presentation seam, caller-owned data and common surface lifecycle. Disabled/absent/disposed inspector must leave normal application flow functional. Do not create new private traversal or feature-specific core branches.
verification: Compare exported graph, selection, dirty/revision, History/Redo around F2/open/close/failure and normal editing before/after helper disposal.
Prove no inspect capture work on ordinary pointermove and bounded on-demand read. Verify failure isolation and stale-lifetime cleanup plus actual generate/save/reopen regression.
Review dependencies/ownership in source, not only screenshot or timing claim; distinguish realistic injected failure/lifecycle tests from physical-device claims.
interpretationLimits: No new product Slice, build-mode gating or production packaging switch inferred merely from the word mode. No promise of physically zero CPU overhead; enforce no semantic coupling and no unnecessary work on ordinary interactions.
authority: Explicit accepted constraint within existing S06 F2-only follow-up. No product acceptance/publication/merge.
